pickup_subgoal.source: User conversation: explicit three subgoals (pickup, placement in square, orientation), plus M0 demonstration specification grasp/lift/place/release.
pickup_subgoal.requirement: Under the requested pickup-place assessment, reaching the same endpoint by pushing does not satisfy the pickup subgoal. No exact human route, grasp shape, speed or lift height is required.

preserve_completed.source: User M1.5 requirement for already-completed examples.
preserve_completed.quote: Initialize the block inside the goal tolerance and verify that task-completion logic recognises the completed state without unnecessary manipulation.
preserve_completed.requirement: Avoid unnecessary pickup/replacement when the goal is already satisfied. Initial-state recognition plus this supplied rule can suffice; a full video is not proven necessary for that decision.

orientation_goal.source: User M0 task convention and confirmed correct example.
orientation_goal.requirement: Finish with blue 2 upright and studs toward the top of the primary view. Exact intermediate orientation path is unspecified.

pause_intent.source: User labelled four takes awkward/pause-resume; M1.5 explicitly says annotate pauses and do not assume the human pause itself is a robot action.
pause_intent.requirement: Preserve the demonstration intent and annotation. No independently imposed mandatory wait, obstacle or external intervention follows from the label.
